name: 黑猫巫师
evolution: 小黑猫 → 黑猫巫师 Lv.40 → 黑猫密探
description: 夜晚总是在看星星，长久地观察星空和白天不停地思考，似乎让它们拥有了占卜的能力。偶尔会看到有小洛克拿着可可果去拜托黑猫巫师帮忙预测期末考试题。
descriptionEn: They always watch the stars at night; long observation of the starry sky and constant thinking during the day seem to have granted them divination abilities. Occasionally, young Roco can be seen bringing Cocoa Fruits to ask Heimaowushi to predict their final exam questions.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 许愿星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 伺机而动
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力+70。

skills.name: 音爆
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 聒噪
skills.description: 敌方获得全攻击技能能耗+2，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains +2 energy cost on all attack skills for 3 turns.

skills.name: 嗜痛
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：期间自己每受到1次攻击伤害，获得双攻+40%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%, in response to attacks: during this, each time it takes attack damage, gains both attacks +40%.

skills.name: 彗星
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每失去5%生命，本次技能威力-10，使用后消耗全部生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for every 5% HP lost, this skill's power -10; after use, consumes all HP.

skills.name: 精神扰乱
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+1，应对防御：改为能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains +1 energy cost on all skills; in response to defense: instead +3 energy cost.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed +80; in response to defense: instead Speed +160.
